# Code style

## Python code generated for spreadsheet work

- Write minimal, concise Python — no unnecessary comments.
- Avoid verbose variable names and redundant operations.
- Drop unnecessary `print` statements.

## Inside the workbook itself

- Add cell comments for complex formulas and important assumptions.
- Document data sources for hardcoded values (see `financial-model-standards.md`).
- Include notes for key calculations and model sections.
